answer: Stop sybils with a reef of marble receipts carried by sparrow couriers. Each identity must anchor one marble receipt in the reef, countersigned by a quorum of sparrow witnesses who each stake their own marble bond. A sparrow may vouch for only one newcomer per epoch, so N fakes need N distinct quorums of honest couriers. If one fake is caught, every identity sharing a voucher in its quorum is slashed too: the reef is connected, so the loss from N clones grows like N squared, not N. A botnet cannot split that risk across machines; it must pay it whole, in marble, up front.
